field_principles.aurc: Area under the risk-coverage curve -- the deployment-facing summary of the abstention gate's quality.
field_principles.certification_method: split-conformal / PAC-Bayes + its assumptions stated -- so a reviewer can audit the certificate's validity.
field_principles.certified_risk_bound: The certified upper bound on selective risk (with delta, n) -- the GUARANTEE that distinguishes this from a mere characterization.
field_principles.coverage_at_operating_point: Fraction the verifier confidently judges (vs abstains) at the selected threshold -- the coverage half of the trade-off.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; blocked_<resource> if a precondition failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reuses cached discriminator scores, no live model).
field_principles.n_calibration: Calibration sample size -- the certificate's strength scales with it; sample-size rigor.
field_principles.n_test: Held-out test size for the risk estimate (n>=100 for a CLT-valid claim).
field_principles.risk_target: The fixed selective-risk target the threshold achieves -- the product spec the operating point meets.
field_principles.selected_threshold: The chosen abstention threshold on the discriminator score -- the deployable operating point.
field_principles.usable_operating_point_exists: BARE bool -- whether a deployable point at the target risk + non-trivial coverage exists; an honest false is a valid finding, not a failure to manufacture.
